visualCharacteristics.purpose: wide body text column beside a narrow sidebar of promo cards or media

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: [body text, headings, lists | sidebar]; in the sidebar each image starts a promo card (image, heading, text, final link as CTA); a lone YouTube/Vimeo link becomes an embedded player

usage: Article and landing page body text with a related office/CTA card or webinar video alongside.
reuseGuidance: Use media-right for an equal-width text and video/photo pair. Use columns-media when both columns are equally weighted without a sidebar card.
